candidates.title: Composable CXL Memory as a Kubernetes-Native Shared Memory for LLM Serving
candidates.reason: Fresh CXL/Kubernetes systems paper: makes composable CXL a schedulable shared KV tier across nodes; reports 5.5-36.6x TTFT reduction for cross-node prefix reuse with only 1-4% sharing gap.

candidates.title: HyMCache: A KV Cache Framework for Multi-Turn LLM Serving with CXL-Hybrid Memory
candidates.reason: Real CXL-hybrid-memory prototype combining device DRAM and SSD-backed capacity for TB-scale KV reuse; 3.0x local LMCache and 1.45x PD-disaggregated serving under equal DRAM budget.

candidates.title: KVServe: Service-Aware KV Cache Compression for Communication-Efficient Disaggregated LLM Serving
candidates.reason: Adaptive service-level KV communication compression for disaggregated serving, with Bayesian profile search and online controller; reports up to 9.13x JCT and 32.8x TTFT improvements.
